whatsappInstructions.title: Instructions for WhatsApp:
whatsappInstructions.animatedStep2: Open WhatsApp and go to any chat.
whatsappInstructions.animatedStep3: Go to the stickers section and tap <1>Create sticker</1>.
whatsappInstructions.animatedStep4: Select the downloaded GIF file and save it.
whatsappInstructions.staticStep2: Open WhatsApp and go to any chat.
whatsappInstructions.staticStep3: Go to the stickers section and tap <1>Create sticker</1>.
whatsappInstructions.staticStep4: Select the downloaded WebP file and save it.

otherAppsInstructions.title: Use Sticker Maker or Sticker.ly:
otherAppsInstructions.animatedStep1: Download the sticker as a <1>GIF</1> or <1>WebP</1>.
otherAppsInstructions.animatedStep2: Install an app like <1>Sticker Maker</1> or <1>Sticker.ly</1>.
otherAppsInstructions.animatedStep3: Open the app, create a sticker pack and select the downloaded file.
otherAppsInstructions.animatedStep4: Tap <1>Add to WhatsApp</1> to have it ready on your keyboard.
otherAppsInstructions.staticStep2: Install an app like <1>Sticker Maker</1> or <1>Sticker.ly</1>.
otherAppsInstructions.staticStep3: Open the app, create a sticker pack and select the downloaded file.
otherAppsInstructions.staticStep4: Tap <1>Add to WhatsApp</1> to have it ready on your keyboard.

terms.section1Text: Stickerity is an online utility tool designed to process and adapt images from public links into formats compatible with messaging applications (such as WhatsApp).
terms.section2Text: Stickerity does not store, host, sell, or claim intellectual property rights over any processed images. The user is solely responsible for acquiring and using content extracted through public links.
terms.section3Text: WhatsApp and other mentioned trademarks belong to their respective owners and are not affiliated with this platform.

privacy.section1Text: Stickerity does not require registration or store personal user data.
privacy.section2Text: Links entered by the user are temporarily processed in memory to convert image formats and are discarded immediately afterward.
privacy.section3Text: We use basic local storage solely for technical caching and application performance.
